verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms Browserbase serves an llms.txt at docs.browserbase.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with agent-oriented content. Doc pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs), and Browserbase Skills give coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex agent-targeted guidance. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs well, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Browserbase Skills teach AI coding agents (like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex) how to browse and interact with the web
